name: Agent teams
summary: Several Claude Code sessions work together as a team, with a lead, a shared task list and direct messages.
what: In an agent team, a lead session coordinates teammates. Each teammate has its own context, picks tasks from a shared list and can message the others. It is experimental, off by default, and uses many more tokens.

impact.title: Many angles at once
impact.detail: Teammates can cover security, performance and tests in parallel.

impact.title: Ideas tested against each other
impact.detail: Teammates can challenge each other's findings.

impact.title: Visible coordination
impact.detail: A shared task list shows who does what.

howItWorks: Set CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 in your settings env block or shell.
Ask Claude in plain words to create a team.
Set teammateMode to tmux or iterm2 to see teammates in split panes.
Press Ctrl+T for the task list.
One team per session; interactive sessions only.

events.note: Added agent teams as a research preview.
